cards.title: AI needs chips beyond the GPU
cards.question: Could optical links and power devices become the next foundry growth engine?
cards.selfCheck: SiGe moves optical bits; test shipments and mix.
cards.prompt: FACT: Sep 17 GF and Marvell expanded SiGe capacity for optical transceivers, NPO and CPO; Nov 4 GF reported record YoY communications infrastructure/data-center growth without a segment-specific dollar bridge. HYPOTHESIS: scaling AI racks creates profitable demand for specialty SiGe and power processes, not only leading-edge logic. TEST next 2-6 months qualified capacity, shipments, data-center revenue and margins. 7d: no independently verified new shipment milestone; 30d: Nov 4 Q3 report; 90d: Sep 17 optical agreement. Sources https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-and-marvell-expand-collaboration-fornext-generation-optical-connectivity/ https://investors.gf.com/news-releases/news-release-details/globalfoundries-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results

cards.title: GFS: the overlooked optical foundry?
cards.question: Does GlobalFoundries capture more AI value through Marvell's optical supply chain?
cards.selfCheck: Marvell needs SiGe; verify GF's profitable volume.
cards.prompt: FACT: GF's Sep 17 expansion with MRVL names pluggable, near-packaged and co-packaged optics. Nov 4 GF Q3 revenue $1.899B, non-IFRS gross margin 31.4%, adjusted FCF $136M; GF reported communications infrastructure/data-center strength but no disclosed SiGe-only revenue. HYPOTHESIS GFS earns foundry economics from growing optical front-end demand. Not a claim that shares are undiscovered or undervalued. TEST product qualifications, disclosed mix, gross margin and free cash flow; counter: insourcing, alternatives, weak yields. https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-and-marvell-expand-collaboration-fornext-generation-optical-connectivity/ https://investors.gf.com/news-releases/news-release-details/globalfoundries-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results

cards.title: A September promise needs a ramp
cards.question: When will the GF–Marvell capacity expansion reach reported revenue?
cards.prompt: ORIGINAL Sep 17 2026 GF–Marvell expanded multi-year SiGe capacity for AI optical connectivity. NEW Nov 4 GF reported strong data-center/communications growth, but did not attribute incremental revenue to the Sep agreement. DIFFERENT CLOCK: Oct 8 $2B TSMC interposer agreement only expects volume in 1H 2028, not a 2027 earnings catalyst. TEST 2027 guidance, wafer starts, SiGe mix, utilization and incremental margins; do not count future interposer contract value as current revenue. https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-and-marvell-expand-collaboration-fornext-generation-optical-connectivity/ https://investors.gf.com/news-releases/news-release-details/globalfoundries-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-reaches-agreement-to-establish-us-based-supply-of-silicon-interposers-for-advanced-ai-packaging/

cards.title: The AI label isn't the earnings bridge
cards.question: Could specialty AI mix improve GFS profits before its headline revenue accelerates?
cards.selfCheck: Mix can lift margins; verify incremental profit.
cards.prompt: FACT Nov 4 GF Q3 revenue $1.899B, non-IFRS gross margin 31.4%, adjusted FCF $136M; IFRS loss included $441M noncash share issuance charge. HYPOTHESIS higher-value SiGe optical mix could raise margins faster than total revenue; offset by new capacity costs. Consensus forecasts and forward multiple not independently verified: do not claim market mispricing. TEST next quarters gross-margin mix, capex, cash conversion, estimate revisions, and independently verified EV/EBIT. https://investors.gf.com/news-releases/news-release-details/globalfoundries-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-and-marvell-expand-collaboration-fornext-generation-optical-connectivity/

cards.title: Watch GFS; don't buy the headline
cards.question: What specific evidence would justify upgrading this optical thesis?
cards.selfCheck: WATCH: SiGe volume + margin; reject weak cash.
cards.prompt: Educational WATCH framework, not personalized trading. In next 2-6 months seek GF commentary on SiGe utilization, optical customer volume, data-center mix and improving incremental operating profit; compare verified forward valuation and estimates before any entry decision. INVALIDATION: optical program delays, poor utilization, gross-margin erosion, capex absorbing cash, or customer sourcing changes. Oct 8 TSMC interposer ramp in 1H 2028 is a long-duration option, not immediate catalyst. https://investors.gf.com/news-releases/news-release-details/globalfoundries-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-and-marvell-expand-collaboration-fornext-generation-optical-connectivity/ https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-reaches-agreement-to-establish-us-based-supply-of-silicon-interposers-for-advanced-ai-packaging/

cards.title: One company, two different clocks
cards.question: Why must you separate a 2027 optical ramp from a 2028 packaging ramp?
cards.selfCheck: Date each milestone; never pull revenue forward.
cards.prompt: Teach the timeline discipline with GF: Sep 17 2026 SiGe/Marvell optical expansion (possible 2027 evidence), Oct 8 2026 $2B TSMC interposer agreement (volume planned 1H 2028), Nov 4 Q3 reported results (not proof either agreement has generated material incremental revenue). Distinguish signed contract, wafer qualification, volume, booked revenue, margin and free cash flow. Use 7/30/90-day continuity without conflating clocks. https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-and-marvell-expand-collaboration-fornext-generation-optical-connectivity/ https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-reaches-agreement-to-establish-us-based-supply-of-silicon-interposers-for-advanced-ai-packaging/ https://investors.gf.com/news-releases/news-release-details/globalfoundries-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results
